name: Dream Daddy: A Dad Dating Simulator
source:
Dream Daddy is a game where you play as a Dad and your goal is to meet and romance other hot Dads. You and your daughter have just moved into the sleepy seaside town of Maple Bay only to discover that everyone in your neighborhood is a single, dateable Dad! Will you go out with Teacher Dad? Goth Dad? Bad Dad? Or any of the other cool Dads in this game? With mini games, side quests, and a variety of paths and endings, Dream Daddy: A Dad Dating Simulator is this year's most anticipated Dad-based game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/654880]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Dream Daddy》是一款游戏，你在游戏中扮演一名爸爸，你的目标是结识其他性感爸爸并与其谈恋爱。你和你的女儿刚刚搬进宁静的海滨小镇枫树湾，却发现附近的每个人都是一个单身、适合约会的爸爸！你会和爸爸老师出去吗？哥特爸爸？坏爸爸？或者这个游戏中其他很酷的爸爸吗？凭借迷你游戏、支线任务以及各种路径和结局，《梦想爸爸：爸爸约会模拟器》是今年最受期待的爸爸游戏。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/654880]Steam[/url]]
